name: Nachel
source:
Race: Female Demon
Origin: Abandoned Desert
Hobby: Reading Fairy tales
Job: Waitress, Bartender

The waitress of Rosey's Restaurant, calm and level-headed, Nachel has little trouble dealing with the drastic changes caused by Rosey. She is a fan of fairy tales and girl's comics.
